'''The Alchemist's Staff''' is a {{Rare}} [[Wand]].

== Obtaining ==
'''The Alchemist's Staff''' is obtained by giving several requested items listed below to {{NPCSprite|Baar}} or {{NPCSprite|Alchemage}}. Alongside '''The Alchemist's Staff''', players will get 250 Reputation for their respective faction.

Items required:
* {{Green|64x}} {{Item|Gold Ingot}}
* {{Green|5x}} {{Item|Golden Plate}}
* {{Green|1x}} {{Item|Diver's Boots}} (Baar) or {{Green|1x}} {{Item|Diver's Mask}} (Alchemage)
* {{Green|1x}} {{Item|Diver's Shirt}} (Baar) or {{Green|1x}} {{Item|Diver's Trunks}} (Alchemage)
* {{Green|32x}} {{Item|Enchanted Gold Block}}
* {{Green|5x}} {{Item|Golden Powder}}
* {{Green|32x}} {{Item|Enchanted Golden Carrot}}
* {{Green|1x}} {{Item|Golden Ball}}

Which costs roughly {{BZC|*64 Gold Ingot *5 Golden Plate *16 Enchanted Sea Lumies *32 Gill Membrane *32 Enchanted Gold Block *5 Golden Powder *32 Enchanted Golden Carrot *1 Golden Ball}} from the [[Bazaar]], alongside a {{Item|Snorkeling Visor}} and {{Item|Snorkeling Pants}}.
